name: Great Weapon Fighting
summary: Treat 1s and 2s on damage dice as 3s with melee weapons held in two hands.

benefits.name: Great Weapon Fighting
benefits.summary: Damage dice of two-handed melee attacks count 1s and 2s as 3s.
benefits.text: When you roll damage for an attack with a Melee weapon you are holding in two hands, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3. The weapon must have the Two-Handed or Versatile property to gain this benefit.
